title: KlaorX
description: A professional, secure, and lightweight management suite inspired by EssentialsX. It features robust moderation tools, a customizable home/warp system, and built-in protection against unauthorized access.
body:
About KlaorX
KlaorX is a high-performance, lightweight, and secure management suite designed for modern Minecraft servers. Built with efficiency in mind, it provides essential tools for server administrators while maintaining a clean and professional experience for players. Whether you are running a small survival server or a large network, KlaorX offers the stability and customization you need.

Core Features
Robust Moderation Tools: Manage your community effectively with advanced Ban, Kick, and Mute systems that support temporary and permanent durations.

Secure Plugin Privacy: Features a built-in protection system that blocks unauthorized players from viewing your server's plugin list, including prefixed bypasses like /bukkit:plugins.

Player Home System: Allows players to set multiple homes with customizable limits, cooldowns, and safety checks.

Global Warp Management: Create public warps for your server with an optional teleportation delay to prevent combat-logging.

Customizable Communication: Includes a formatted private messaging system and professional broadcast tools for staff announcements.

Highly Configurable: Nearly every message, prefix, and setting can be adjusted through a well-documented config.yml file.

Why Choose KlaorX?
Unlike bloated management plugins, KlaorX is optimized to run with minimal resource usage. It focuses on providing a secure environment by preventing information leaks and ensuring that staff members have the precise tools they need to moderate effectively.
